description: RS Cross Latitude is a mod that solves the problem of "Refined Storage" being unable to transmit across latitudes.

releases.notes: - Fixed translation error of the name.

## Refined Storage Cross Latitude Network Support  Now, your RS network can connect across different dimensions (worlds)
 - Support cross-dimensional access for all devices (disk drives, processors, interfaces, etc.) in the RS network.
 - Cross-dimensional transmission does not consume additional energy, but it is necessary to ensure that the target dimensional block undergoes strong loading.
## Precautions
- **Network Receivers and Network Transmitters will aggressively load the current block**: When utilizing cross-dimensional functionality, please be aware that these two devices will aggressively load the block they are in to ensure stable cross-dimensional communication. This may result in increased server performance overhead, and it is recommended to plan their placement accordingly.
